description: This file contains the ShareProductRepositoryWrapper class, which acts as a wrapper for the ShareProductRepository, providing methods to find, save, and flush ShareProduct entities with detection for not found cases.

classes.name: ShareProductRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A service class that wraps the ShareProductRepository to provide higher-level operations with additional detection logic.

methods.name: findOneWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Finds a ShareProduct by ID, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: saveAndFlush
methods.description: Saves and immediately flushes changes of a ShareProduct entity.
